## About
Wheel Accent+Used tires Decatur is a used tire shop on Panthersville Road, right off Candler Road. Neighbors from Flat Shoals and all over Decatur come to us when they need a decent tire at a fair price.
We keep it simple: good used tires, flat repairs and wheel work, done quickly and explained plainly. Customers have given us a 4.6 rating from 43 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used tires: Good used tires for your car, from our shop on Panthersville Road.
- Tire repair: Flat or damaged tire? We'll repair it, explain what went wrong and get you going.
- Wheel repair: Wheel work and rims alongside our used tires.
